positions.title: Jr. Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Full Stack Web Development

Java (Maven, Spring, FasterXML/Jackson, JUnit) 
Python (Flask, SQLAlchemy, Pytest) 
JavaScript (React/Redux, Ramda, Jest/Enzyme testing, ESLint) 
PostgreSQL 
Ubuntu Linux dev environment 
Git source control 
Agile Development 
 
My team develops web applications with modern client-side UIs, server-side REST APIs, and SQL database persistence. I solely developed a complete Java CLI for our project that interfaces with our Flask REST API. I also make large contributions to the React/Redux front-end and Python Flask back-end. We are responsible to write our own Unit tests for every feature implemented. All development is tracked via Git source control, and thoroughly documented (README and Swagger).

- Management and Sales at a high-end full detailing shop with 10+ employees
